book.title: The Ledger Under Rain
book.premise: Archive clerk Lin Qiao finds a living witness recorded as dead while a flood-threatened city treats every public correction as a debt someone must personally pay.
book.theme: Truth becomes accountable only when its beneficiaries accept its cost.
book.reader_promise: Every recovered fact forces a harder public choice and every victory changes the city's material balance.
book.ending_intent: Lin Qiao opens the revision ledger to the city, accepts a named civic debt, and replaces secret guardianship with accountable public custody.

volumes.title: The Rain Ledger
volumes.goal: Preserve the erased death entry and locate its living subject before the next archive purge.
volumes.pressure: Central Archive auditors and the Quiet Office close every lawful path while floodwater reaches the lower stacks.
volumes.reward: Lin Qiao proves the record was revised and gains Shen Rui's hidden trail.
volumes.cost: Lin Qiao loses procedural immunity and becomes personally liable for the disputed record.
volumes.ending_escalation: The witness trail points into a district scheduled to be deliberately flooded.

volumes.title: The Dead Name Quarter
volumes.goal: Find Shen Rui and bring one verifiable fragment of her testimony out of the condemned ward.
volumes.pressure: The Harbor Guild trades evacuation places for silence while the district's names disappear from civic maps.
volumes.reward: Shen Rui survives and identifies the first member of the revision chain.
volumes.cost: Mei An burns her engineering clearance to open a tide gate and thousands learn Lin Qiao caused the breach.
volumes.ending_escalation: Shen Rui reveals that Lin Qiao's mother signed the original debt seal.

volumes.title: Borrowed Names
volumes.goal: Trace the market that converts erased identities into civic credit without exposing Shen Rui prematurely.
volumes.pressure: Debt brokers weaponize public sympathy and offer Lin Qiao proof in exchange for another person's name.
volumes.reward: The team recovers the ledger key that links identities to physical tide-gate decisions.
volumes.cost: Luo Jue publishes an incomplete truth and Lin Qiao's relationship with Shen Rui fractures.
volumes.ending_escalation: The recovered key shows that a correction can trigger a citywide resource seizure.

volumes.title: The Salt Tribunal
volumes.goal: Defend the evidence before the Civic Debt Court and separate Yu Lan's coercion from consent.
volumes.pressure: Salt-corrupted memory glass makes every fact contestable and Director Wu offers a legally clean false settlement.
volumes.reward: Yu Lan's seal is reclassified as coerced and the court recognizes audit shadows as evidence.
volumes.cost: Lin Qiao accepts a seven-year civic debt to keep the case open.
volumes.ending_escalation: The ruling exposes a hidden Quiet Office mandate above the court.

volumes.title: The Quiet Office
volumes.goal: Enter the institution that edits crises before the public can name them and identify its governing doctrine.
volumes.pressure: The Office can erase access without erasing traces, forcing the team to choose which relationships become evidence.
volumes.reward: Director Wu's erased signature proves he tried to stop one purge before directing later ones.
volumes.cost: Mei An learns Lin Qiao withheld evidence that could clear her father and leaves the team.
volumes.ending_escalation: The Office's archive predicts a deliberate failure of all eight tide bells.

volumes.title: The Drowned Parliament
volumes.goal: Build a temporary coalition capable of preventing the planned flood without granting any faction secret custody of the ledger.
volumes.pressure: Ward mutuals, the Harbor Guild, and the Archive Council each demand exclusive control of one indispensable resource.
volumes.reward: The coalition establishes distributed custody and opens seven tide gates.
volumes.cost: The eighth gate remains shut and Shen Rui voluntarily enters Quiet Office custody to prevent mass retaliation.
volumes.ending_escalation: The submerged coordinate from Chapter 27 locates the missing eighth bell below the old parliament.

volumes.title: The Eighth Bell
volumes.goal: Recover the bell mechanism and determine why every official history omits its sound.
volumes.pressure: Echo-reading the bell consumes autobiographical memory and Director Wu races to destroy it before the storm peak.
volumes.reward: Lin Qiao restores the bell and proves the flood plan was designed as a recurring political reset.
volumes.cost: Lin Qiao loses the memory of her last ordinary day with Yu Lan.
volumes.ending_escalation: When the bell rings, the city's public records become temporarily unreadable.

volumes.title: The City Without Records
volumes.goal: Keep food, evacuation, and justice functioning while no centralized record can be trusted.
volumes.pressure: Local truth systems diverge, old enemies become necessary witnesses, and counterfeit debts spread faster than corrections.
volumes.reward: Neighborhood ledgers converge on a verifiable shared protocol independent of the Archive Council.
volumes.cost: Luo Jue dies protecting the protocol's first public synchronization, leaving his earlier false report unresolved.
volumes.ending_escalation: The restored network reveals a final purge command signed with Lin Qiao's own credentials.

volumes.title: Public Revision
volumes.goal: Prove the forged command, recover Shen Rui, and decide whether exposing every revision would create a second catastrophe.
volumes.pressure: Citizens demand total disclosure while bad actors map vulnerable witnesses from partial releases.
volumes.reward: The team establishes staged disclosure with witness-controlled redaction and proves the forgery.
volumes.cost: Director Wu dies stopping the purge he helped build, denying Lin Qiao a simple public villain.
volumes.ending_escalation: The city votes to make Lin Qiao the sole temporary custodian—the exact power she opposed.

volumes.title: Accountable Dawn
volumes.goal: Transfer the ledger into durable public custody while the storm, factional violence, and Lin Qiao's own authority peak together.
volumes.pressure: Every available shortcut would save lives now by recreating unaccountable power later.
volumes.reward: The revision ledger, tide gates, and debt court enter a distributed constitutional protocol.
volumes.cost: Lin Qiao accepts the named debt for harms caused by disclosure and permanently loses echo-reading power.
volumes.ending_escalation: The city survives without a hidden guardian, and the first ordinary citizen files a correction against Lin Qiao herself.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A concrete contradiction breaks the prior equilibrium.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Ground the volume objective and current state.
chapter_pattern.hook: The anomaly names an immediate personal risk.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Refusal becomes more expensive than action.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Show who controls the first resource.
chapter_pattern.hook: A lawful route closes.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The protagonists test one world rule under pressure.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Clarify a limit and its enforcement owner.
chapter_pattern.hook: The rule produces an unintended trace.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Allies want incompatible uses of the same evidence.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Expose a relationship fault line.
chapter_pattern.hook: One ally withholds a reason.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A choice consumes money, access, memory, or trust.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Update the resource ledger.
chapter_pattern.hook: The spent resource was also a safeguard.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The volume goal becomes a bounded operation.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Define success evidence and failure consequence.
chapter_pattern.hook: The target has already moved.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A clue helps only if its lineage can survive review.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Add a source and a reliability limit.
chapter_pattern.hook: The clue implicates an ally.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The opposing faction reacts intelligently.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Reveal the opponent's incentive.
chapter_pattern.hook: The countermeasure changes the timeline.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Two necessary uses compete for one scarce resource.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Record the rejected use as future debt.
chapter_pattern.hook: The abandoned party acts alone.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A visible win inverts the tactical position.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Separate fact gained from leverage lost.
chapter_pattern.hook: The win activates an obligation.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A character acts on a plausible but incomplete belief.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Make knowledge boundaries explicit.
chapter_pattern.hook: The audience sees the missing premise.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A promise or mystery is opened with a due window.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Bind setup to a future payoff function.
chapter_pattern.hook: Payment requires a named cost.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Evidence gathering competes with a deadline.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Connect two previously separate facts.
chapter_pattern.hook: The connection creates a new suspect.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A faction changes coalition or public posture.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Update power legitimacy and maintenance cost.
chapter_pattern.hook: The public reason differs from the private one.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The volume objective remains valid but its meaning changes.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Reveal a causal layer, not merely a secret.
chapter_pattern.hook: The revelation makes the old plan harmful.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The midpoint truth causes an irreversible external effect.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Update world and relationship state.
chapter_pattern.hook: A beneficiary refuses the benefit.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Trust breaks over method rather than misunderstanding.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Expose incompatible values and mutual dependency.
chapter_pattern.hook: Separation creates operational vulnerability.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A character pays before success is assured.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Advance the character arc through action.
chapter_pattern.hook: The sacrifice empowers an opponent too.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The immediate obstacle appears closed.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Show which ledger remains inconsistent.
chapter_pattern.hook: One immutable trace contradicts closure.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The cost of the apparent resolution arrives.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Move a resource, debt, or promise to a worse state.
chapter_pattern.hook: The cost has a public owner.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The team must rebuild a plan with fewer assets.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Recall the volume's first rule or clue.
chapter_pattern.hook: A discarded option becomes necessary.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: An earlier fact becomes actionable in a changed context.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Demonstrate provenance-preserving recall.
chapter_pattern.hook: The recalled fact was interpreted by the wrong holder.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The opponent offers a real benefit at a systemic cost.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Clarify the opponent's coherent end state.
chapter_pattern.hook: Accepting would resolve a personal obligation.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The protagonists choose a method that narrows future options.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Record the causal commitment.
chapter_pattern.hook: The choice becomes public before execution.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Multiple earlier choices interact.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Update faction, resource, and relationship state together.
chapter_pattern.hook: The cascade reaches an uninvolved district.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The team converts evidence into an executable plan.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Ground roles, constraints, and failure recovery.
chapter_pattern.hook: One role depends on a damaged relationship.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: A long obligation enters its payoff window.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Recall setup and verify prerequisites.
chapter_pattern.hook: The cheapest payoff would violate the theme.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: Competing plans collide in the same place and time.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Resolve the tactical question with causal action.
chapter_pattern.hook: Victory exposes the final moral choice.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The protagonist chooses who bears the cost.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Advance the core arc and close one false belief.
chapter_pattern.hook: The choice cannot contain every consequence.

chapter_pattern.pressure_delta: The volume promise pays while a larger pressure becomes concrete.
chapter_pattern.information_gain: Close due obligations and freeze the new state.
chapter_pattern.hook: The next volume begins from the consequence, not a reset.

world_rules.statement: Every official record revision leaves an immutable audit shadow even when the visible record is erased.
world_rules.function: Limits secret edits and creates provenance conflicts.

world_rules.statement: A public correction requires a named sponsor to accept measurable civic debt for resulting disruption.
world_rules.function: Makes truth costly and prevents effortless exposure.

world_rules.statement: Saltwater can corrupt memory-glass playback but cannot remove the audit shadow stored in its edge lattice.
world_rules.function: Separates readable evidence from durable identity.

world_rules.statement: Echo-reading reconstructs revision traces by consuming an autobiographical memory of comparable emotional weight.
world_rules.function: Constrains power and makes distant recall materially costly.

world_rules.statement: A tide gate opens only when two independently owned keys agree within one bell interval.
world_rules.function: Forces coalition and prevents single-faction control.

world_rules.statement: A living witness owns the release timing of identifying testimony unless an immediate mass-casualty exception is adjudicated.
world_rules.function: Protects knowledge boundaries and blocks instrumental disclosure.

characters.name: Lin Qiao
characters.role: protagonist archive clerk and reluctant echo-reader
characters.external_goal: preserve and disclose the revision ledger without recreating secret custody
characters.internal_need: accept responsibility instead of treating procedure as moral neutrality
characters.fear: becoming the unaccountable guardian she opposes
characters.flaw: withholds choices when she believes others cannot bear the risk
characters.opening_belief: a correct procedure makes the actor innocent
characters.final_change: public accountability includes accepting correction against oneself
characters.forbidden_behavior: does not knowingly fabricate evidence or abandon an identified civilian for procedural convenience

characters.name: Mei An
characters.role: flood engineer, ally, and moral counterweight
characters.external_goal: keep tide infrastructure in accountable operation
characters.internal_need: separate loyalty to people from loyalty to systems
characters.fear: her engineering choices will repeat her father's hidden compromise
characters.flaw: treats urgent technical necessity as sufficient consent
characters.opening_belief: a city can survive first and explain later
characters.final_change: legitimacy is part of infrastructure reliability
characters.forbidden_behavior: does not accept preventable mass flooding for political leverage

characters.name: Shen Rui
characters.role: living witness recorded as dead and former registrar
characters.external_goal: control how her testimony enters public record
characters.internal_need: reclaim identity without becoming only evidence
characters.fear: survival will be used to erase those who did not survive
characters.flaw: tests allies through silence until collaboration becomes dangerous
characters.opening_belief: every institution turns witnesses into property
characters.final_change: conditional public trust can be designed and revoked
characters.forbidden_behavior: does not surrender another witness's identity to buy her own safety

characters.name: Director Wu
characters.role: Quiet Office director and institutional antagonist
characters.external_goal: preserve city continuity through controlled revision
characters.internal_need: admit that stability without appeal is prolonged violence
characters.fear: unfiltered truth will trigger cascading civil failure
characters.flaw: counts hidden victims as acceptable uncertainty
characters.opening_belief: someone must own the lie citizens cannot survive
characters.final_change: uses his last authority to destroy the purge path rather than the evidence
characters.forbidden_behavior: does not pursue chaos, wealth, or cruelty for its own sake

characters.name: Luo Jue
characters.role: investigative broadcaster, rival, and later protocol witness
characters.external_goal: make hidden revisions impossible to contain
characters.internal_need: learn that speed without provenance transfers harm to witnesses
characters.fear: truth arriving too late becomes another lie
characters.flaw: publishes before affected people can contest framing
characters.final_change: dies preserving a protocol that can correct his own reporting
characters.forbidden_behavior: does not knowingly sell a source to a state or faction

characters.name: Yu Lan
characters.role: Lin Qiao's absent mother and coerced original debt sponsor
characters.external_goal: encoded in past evidence: prevent the eighth-gate reset
characters.internal_need: leave Lin Qiao a choice rather than a hereditary duty
characters.fear: her daughter will inherit both guilt and secret power
characters.opening_belief: one hidden custodian can buy time
characters.final_change: posthumous evidence releases custody instead of transferring it
characters.forbidden_behavior: did not voluntarily authorize civilian sacrifice
